recognize_zh: 厚且散開不佳的骨髓顆粒，被大量大小不一的脂肪空泡與基質網絡占據，造血細胞稀少、呈聚集團塊；可辨認的是化療後低細胞、以基質為主的顆粒，感染的具體證據無法在這張圖上看到。
features: Thick marrow particle with numerous variably sized fat vacuoles
Stromal/reticular network with clumped, poorly spread cells within the particle
Relatively few individually recognizable hematopoietic precursors, suggesting reduced cellularity
Scattered lymphocytes and occasional neutrophils at the edge of the particle
Thick preparation and overlapping cells limit cytologic evaluation; no organisms identified
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a thick marrow particle composed largely of fat vacuoles and a stromal network with clustered, poorly spread cells. Individually identifiable hematopoietic precursors are sparse, and scattered lymphocytes and occasional neutrophils are present at the particle periphery. No microorganisms, granulomas, or blast population can be identified, although the thickness of the preparation limits cytologic assessment. Findings suggest a hypocellular, stroma-rich post-chemotherapy marrow; specific features of infection are not demonstrable in this image and would require stains, cultures, and biopsy correlation.

ddx.vs: Also shows fat-rich hypocellular particles, but occurs without chemotherapy history and with a particle composed of lymphocytes, plasma cells and mast cells alone.
Shows pink-purple amorphous extracellular ground substance with fat cell atrophy rather than intact fat vacuoles.
Would show epithelioid histiocyte clusters or organisms within macrophages, which are not identified here.
Requires identification of blasts or abnormal cells, better evaluated on well-spread areas, flow cytometry and biopsy.
